description: Syntax guide for the diagrams and infographics MindMax renders: mind map, flowchart / swim lanes, org chart, bar / line / pie chart, Gantt, timeline, fishbone, SWOT, Venn, quadrant, radar, and template infographics (steps, cycle, pyramid, funnel, comparison, key figures). Returns the tested syntax skeleton, label limits, and how to cite the source text so every label and number can be checked. Call it before writing a diagram for open_diagram_in_mindmax; pass `type` when you know it, or omit it to get every type with when to use it. With `type: "cards"` it returns the card-draft format for open_cards_in_mindmax (long text → image carousel).

density.description: cards only: brief (4–6 cards), standard (6–9, default) or detailed (9–14)

language.description: cards only: language of the source text (sets the length budgets); defaults to en

type.description: Diagram type; omit or "auto" to get every type with when to use it; "cards" for the card-draft format

name: get_mindmax_diagram_guide
title: MindMax diagram guide
